answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mesa of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the umber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
